name: ppt-editorial
description: Reference-quality 16:9 slide deck harness driven by image generation, with a four-stage director/generate/critic pipeline.

interface.shortDescription: Reference-quality slide decks via image generation with a director/critic loop.
interface.longDescription: Produce reference-quality 16:9 decks where every text, diagram and icon is rendered inside the generated image. A four-stage multi-agent pipeline (design director -> parallel image generation -> design critic -> loop) enforces visual consistency. Includes two style profiles (editorial, modern flat), a 12-archetype modern-flat gallery with catalog, refined-scale and meaningful-decor defaults, and a hybrid report mode that embeds real screenshots (dashboards, tables, sheets) into matching frames.
defaultPrompt: Build a modern-flat result report deck from these materials.
Make an editorial-style pitch deck matching this reference image.
Create a 40-slide report that embeds my real dashboard screenshots.
